acceptance.struggle.title: Struggle / rework / outstanding
acceptance.struggle.tip: The rework a clean all-pass report would otherwise hide: FAIL rounds, send-backs, leftover follow-ups, multiple PR cycles and review/done reopens. Always shown — an empty trail states its basis instead of disappearing.

acceptance.trend.title: Trend

securityScan.section.title: Security scan
securityScan.section.empty: No security scans yet — a scan runs on every push to a linked pull request.
securityScan.disposition.inherited: carried over from an earlier commit
securityScan.action.error: Could not save the decision. Please try again.
securityScan.banner.blocking: {count, plural, one {# high-severity finding is} other {# high-severity findings are}} undispositioned — this task cannot move to Done until a human reviews them.
securityScan.judgeUnavailable: LLM review did not complete — only pattern matching ran.
securityScan.truncated: The diff was truncated before LLM review; large changes may be under-reviewed.
securityScan.external.notConfigured: Lumo's managed scanner is off for this deployment and this repository has never pushed a scanner report, so only Lumo's own checks ran. A clean result here is not a full pass.
securityScan.external.notConfigured.link: Create a CI ingest key (for pushing your own scanner's SARIF)
securityScan.external.late: The scanner has not reported for this commit in 30 minutes, so this scan is incomplete. Push a new commit to start a fresh scan, or check your own CI's scan job if this repository pushes its own reports.
securityScan.partial: Some results were cut off at the scan budget — the scan is not complete.
